notes: Authored in this repository by extracting the brainstorm skill. There is no upstream pin and no custody table.

skills/brainstorm/scripts/shaping_judgments.py is the command surface. It loads typesafe_client, jev_log, and retry_backoff from the generated _bundled directory beside the script. fleet-bundle.json declares those destinations. --help exits before any request. TYPESAFE_ is stripped because the script reads TYPESAFE_API_KEY only when a judgment actually runs, and a missing key fails open.
